title: Sky partitions all activity into exactly six Scopes, each with its own Alignment Artifact
content:
A.0.1.1.13 fixes six Scopes as Sky's focus areas: **Governance** (Artifact interpretation and balance of powers), **Support** (ecosystem support, tools, Sky Primitives), **Stability** (financial stability, the USDS stablecoin), **Protocol** (technical development, maintenance, security), **Accessibility** (frontends and distribution), and **Agent** (all Agent Artifacts).

A.0.1.1.15 gives each Scope its own Scope Alignment Artifact, providing "a framework for decision-making, resource allocation, and governance within the defined Scope," on the reasoning that each Scope has distinct challenges requiring a tailored approach.

The boundary rule carries the enforcement: "Scope Artifacts must not be changed beyond the Scope boundaries defined by the Atlas; this constitutes Slippery Slope Misalignment." Scope creep is not merely disorderly — it is explicitly classified as the compounding failure mode, which gives the partition teeth beyond organizational tidiness.
description: Governance, Support, Stability, Protocol, Accessibility and Agent Scopes divide the ecosystem; a Scope Artifact must not be changed beyond its Atlas-defined boundary.
